label: anthropic-sonnet-4.6
_note: Seven endpoints across Anthropic, Google Vertex, Amazon Bedrock and Azure, all serving the same dated snapshot. NOT pinned to first-party Anthropic: this account's data policy excludes that endpoint, and a pin at a blocked endpoint plus allow_fallbacks:false is an unroutable request, not a fallback. Verified reachable 2026-08-12. Same tag as the Sonnet 5 leg so the version-bump control differs by checkpoint only, not by serving stack. Shares the 'anthropic' family with that leg, so their pairs are the version-bump control rather than cross-vendor pairs.

label: anthropic-sonnet-5
_note: Eight endpoints across Anthropic, Google, Amazon Bedrock and Azure. Cheaper than 4.6 and the checkpoint the pipeline actually runs, so it is the one a diversification strategy would be applied to. Bedrock for the same reason as the 4.6 leg: first-party Anthropic is blocked by account data policy, and both Anthropic legs must share a stack.

label: openai-gpt-5.6-sol
_note: Flagship of the 5.6 line; terra ($1/$6) and luna ($0.10/$0.60) are the mid and cheap tiers of the same generation. Matched on tier rather than price: an odd result on a mid tier could not be told apart from house style. First-party OpenAI is blocked by account data policy and the Bedrock endpoint does not serve this model, so Azure standard is the only reachable option. Verified 2026-08-12.

label: xai-grok-4.6
_note: Four endpoints, all first-party xAI: standard, priority, and zero-data-retention variants of each. Pinned to xai/zdr, which costs the same as standard and is the better default for a children's product. Cheapest output of the slate at $6/MTok. First-party is reachable here, unlike Anthropic's and OpenAI's.

label: moonshot-kimi-k3
_note: The strongest case in this slate for pinning at all: an open-weight model with FOURTEEN endpoints across twelve resellers at genuinely different quantizations (fp4, mxfp4, fp8, bf16, and five reporting unknown). The default route is Morph at fp4. Pinned to the first-party Moonshot AI endpoint at mxfp4, the only leg whose endpoint reports a quantization at all. Also the widest departure in training corpus from the four US labs, which is what makes a vendor effect detectable if one exists.

label: google-gemini-3.1-pro
_note: Six endpoints across Google Vertex and Google AI Studio, each with standard/flex/priority tiers, same dated snapshot and same price. AI Studio is blocked by account data policy, so Vertex global standard it is. max_completion_tokens is 65,536 here against 128,000 for the others; the 5-8 skeletons need under 12,000 so it does not bind. A -preview slug can be retired without notice; re-verify before a run.
